Tara Gomez: Heads-up — we're scheduling a base-image rebuild this Wed 09:00 PT. Need KMS signer rotation and RBAC preflight.
Simon Park: timeline ok for infra? we need to freeze image pushes 30m before.
Ahmad Khan: which key? /keys/image-signer-v2? KMS rotation planned Thu in staging.
Tara Gomez: yes key = projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-v2
Jen Liu: are there artifact-provenance attestations? cosign or internal signer?
Simon Park: cosign + internal attestation service. cosign keys are signed by KMS signer-v1 -> v2.
security-bot: NOTE: recent vuln scan flagged glibc 2.35 in base. recommend minimal rebuild.
Tara Gomez: We'll do a minified rootfs, drop setuid binaries, run sbom and attestation.
Ahmad Khan: RBAC change: only 'image-builder' iam service account + 'attest-runner' group can sign. Need IAM PR.
Tara Gomez: @Jen Liu can you prepare the IAM policy change, include admin review + 7-day rollout?
Jen Liu: ok — I'll open PR with terraform change and add canaries. adding log filter: resource.type="container_image" severity>="NOTICE".
Simon Park: For the restart plan: build pool scales, we'll drain nodes with 5m buffer, patch pipeline webhook to point to signer-v2 endpoint.
Tara Gomez: command we'll run for cosign signing:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-v2 -a sbom.json redwood/base:2026-03-21
```
Jen Liu: Add preflight check:
- verify cosign can access KMS (gcloud auth)
- run sbom generation
- run E2E container smoke
Ahmad Khan: Audit logging: ensure KMS CloudAudit logs forwarded to splunk index=security-kms and image-attest logs to audit-logstore.
Tara Gomez: Incident readiness: if signing fails fallback to signer-v1 for 12h with explicit override + audit tag.
Simon Park: let's add a short runbook in runbooks/image-rebuild.md and schedule a 30min preflight call Tue 16:00 PT.
Tara Gomez: ack. I'll DM product to hold any deploys touching runtime until patch.
Jen Liu: PR: #4217 created, link https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/4217 :eyes: 
Ahmad Khan: quick q — do we rotate cosign key material or only KMS? I prefer KMS only for now.
Tara Gomez: KMS-only rotation. we will refresh cosign wrapper after tests.
Simon Park: lgtm. I'll post canary window in #release-war-room.
Tara Gomez: thanks team :thumbsup:
